Name: Wedding Invitations
Author: mieukie
Description:
[center][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Do you have ENEMIES or townsfolk who you've barely ever spoken to that you don't want showing up to your ceremony? Have you ever wished that the Wizard, or Gus, or even THAT GRIZZLY BEAR FROM THE SECRET FOREST could be the one to unite you and your spouse in holy matrimony instead of Mayor Lewis?? Then this mod is for you!![/font][/size][/center]



[center][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][u]How it works[/u][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]The day after you propose to your partner, you will get a cutscene outside the farmhouse with the wedding invitation menu.[/font][/size][/center]

[center][font=Comic Sans MS][b][u][size=4]What it does[/size][/u][/b]
This mod will hide any NPCs you don't invite to your wedding, as well as replace Mayor Lewis as the officiant (if you choose to) with pretty much any NPC you want. The wedding speech is modified to be a bit less mayor-y.[/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]


[font=Comic Sans MS][b][u][size=4]Multiplayer[/size][/u][/b][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]The mod works in multiplayer, but [b]only players who have the mod installed will see the custom guest choices[/b]. (Ex: if you have the mod installed, but a friend doesn't, you will see the wedding scene with your chosen guests/officiant, but your friend will see a completely vanilla wedding. If you both have the mod installed, you both will see the custom guests chosen by whoever's getting married.) If you are doing a player-to-player wedding, definitely have both players install the mod to avoid possible bugs![/font]


[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b][u]In Case of Oops[/u][/b][/font][/size]
[font=Comic Sans MS]If you change your mind or made a mistake and need to edit your guest list/officiant choices after you submitted them, you can either directly edit the "config.json" file in this mod's folder, or if you have the "Generic Mod Configuration Menu" mod installed, use the cog icon on the title screen / the "Mod Options" button at the bottom of the in-game settings to edit the guest list there![/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS] [/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=4][u][b]Weird Stuff[/b][/u][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Mayor Lewis can ONLY attend the wedding as the officiant, since the guest list is based on vanilla and he was never coded to be a guest in vanilla (i didn't want to add him to the scene myself as his position could overlap/clash with other mods who add their own NPCs into the scene). But for lore reasons you can just pretend he got sad after you told him you wanted someone else officiating and he declined to attend after that[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If you choose your spouse as the officiant, they technically can give the speech, but they'll be talking about themselves in the third person and standing weirdly in front of you instead of beside you, so unless you're into that, it's not recommended.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If you choose the Governor he will be holding a spoonful of soup throughout your entire wedding ceremony. I am choosing to call this a feature, not a bug...[/font][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][u][b]Compatibility w/ Other Mods[/b][/u][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod SHOULD work with others that add custom NPCs such as SVE, Ridgeside, Shiko, etc. AND multiple spouse/polyamory mods.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Using this mod in combination with any others that alter the wedding scene could result in weird dialogue, incorrect NPC positioning, dizziness, fainting, and possibly death. [color=#ffe599][b][size=4]Some bugs may be unavoidable but feel free to leave a comment if you encounter something funky and I'll see if I can fix it![/size][/b][/color][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]I specifically added some stuff to make this mod work with the [color=#6d9eeb][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29885][u]Custom Wedding Ceremony[/u][/url][/color] mod because I think that one's cute! Just be sure to invite your spouse's family though because otherwise they'll give a speech at the wedding without their sprite actually being there. (it doesn't break anything, it's just kinda awkward...)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]If your custom NPC mod didn't set up their NPCs to be a guests at the wedding, you will not have the option to invite them in this mod. (ex: SVE modded their villagers to stand in the back of the wedding scene, so you have the option to invite those guys, but Ridgeside did not add their villagers anywhere in that scene, so no Ridgeside NPCs will be able to show up as guests, despite the fact that many of them CAN be your officiant... yeah it's odd lol)[/font][/*]
[/list]
